nad18cbdd11.headline: Stock Market Rises 6.6% and Dollar Falls 4% on Day of Political Crisis
nad18cbdd11.summary: The Ibovespa index gained 6.6%, its largest daily percentage increase since January 2009, while the Brazilian real weakened more than 4% against the dollar amid political turmoil.
nad18cbdd11.why: The Ibovespa is Brazil's main stock market index, and its sharp rise alongside currency moves reflects investor reactions to political developments affecting economic stability.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: Political crisis triggered a rally in the stock market as investors adjusted risk perceptions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nad18cbdd11.why_moved: The political crisis in Brazil caused investors to reprice risk, boosting equities while weakening the currency amid uncertainty.
